history_summary.value: The Speckledy is a modern hybrid from a Rhode Island Red and Marans cross, with feathering like a Cuckoo Marans, bred as a prolific layer of speckled chestnut-brown eggs.

summary.value: The Speckledy, also sold as the Speckled Ranger, is a modern hybrid laying hen made by crossing a Rhode Island Red rooster with a Marans hen. It takes after the Marans side in looks, with barred, cuckoo style feathers that are soft and plentiful. The birds are large but neat, with a deep breast, an upturned tail, pale legs, pale bay eyes and a medium red single comb. Hens are strong layers, putting out around 250 to 270 dark chestnut brown eggs a year, often with speckles. The shells are notably tough and the yolks a deep yellow. Speckledys are docile and easy to handle, and they enjoy foraging, so they do best with room to range on grass. Their calm nature and steady laying make them a common choice for first time keepers who mainly want brown eggs.
